title: Regras de Condição Final, leitura e símbolo de localização — p. 14
scopeLimits: This batch proposes the post-reading turn sequence, one End Condition rule, and the Location type Symbol explanation on page 14.
It preserves source Optima regular 10 pt, source color and geometry, and uses an 11 pt source-matched leading for the three-line paragraph.

The glossary-approved End Conditions → Condições Finais and Encounter → Encontro forms are used. “Location type Symbol” is rendered descriptively as “Símbolo de Tipo de Local”; this does not create a glossary decision. Existing approved content is preserved. No final translation was written.

candidates.sourceText: After reading, starting with the first Initiative Card, figures take their turns. At the end of each round shuffle the Initiative Track before going onto the next round. Continue through rounds until an End Condition is reached.
candidates.proposalText: Após a leitura, as miniaturas realizam turnos a partir da primeira Carta de Iniciativa. Embaralhe a Trilha de Iniciativa ao fim de cada rodada, antes da próxima. Continue até alcançar uma Condição Final.
